I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Hasina’s own governing style treated human welfare as the overriding purpose across the whole state. The counterevidence is broader and more direct: repression, censorship, violent crisis response, and worsening poverty/inequality.","evidence":[{"title":"World Bank Helps Bangladesh Provide Basic Services, Opportunities, and Build Resilience for Displaced Rohingya and Host Communities","publisher":"World Bank","date":"May 28, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/05/28/world-bank-helps-bangladesh-provide-basic-services-opportunities-and-build-resilience-for-displaced-rohingya-and-host-co","summary":"Bangladesh, with World Bank support, funded health, nutrition, education, water, shelters, livelihood support, and GBV prevention for Rohingya and host communities. This is the strongest positive evidence that welfare was treated as a real policy object, though it is still largely externally financed and crisis-specific.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.8","5B.10"]},{"title":"UNFPA Bangladesh Annual Report 2024","publisher":"UNFPA Bangladesh","date":"2024","url":"https://bangladesh.unfpa.org/en/unfpa-bangladesh-annual-report-2024","summary":"UNFPA delivered targeted services to women, girls, indigenous communities, transgender people, sex workers, and disaster-affected districts, including emergency reproductive health and cash assistance. This is a real pro-welfare governance signal because it addresses health-system quality, not just visibility or patronage.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.9","5B.10"]},{"title":"Bangladesh - Cash Transfer Modernization Project: Improving Transparency and Efficiency of Safety Nets","publisher":"World Bank","date":"January 1, 2024","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099739201032424234","summary":"Bangladesh already had cash-transfer programs aimed at the poorest and most socially excluded, including widows, older people, and disabled people. This is strong counterevidence: a ruler treating control and intimidation as more important than the welfare of citizens’ rights and safety.","question_ids":["6B.1","3B.3","5B.1"]},{"title":"Bangladesh: Türk decries government crackdown, urges respect for international human rights standards","publisher":"United Nations / OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"more than 170 people were reported killed, some injured people were denied medical care, and the UN said there was no effort to protect people from attacks by groups affiliated with the government. This is strong evidence that 2024 did not leave welfare on a clearly better trajectory for ordinary people.","question_ids":["6B.1","5B.9","5B.10","5B.8"]}]}
